{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with highest sample_seq per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Verify: now each patient appears once
print(f'Number of unique patients after deduplication: {df_dedup.shape[0]}')

# Check if any patient_id remains duplicated
print(f'Duplicate patient_id after deduplication: {df_dedup.duplicated(subset="patient_id").sum()}')

# Check the site distribution
print('\nSite distribution:')
df_dedup['site'].value_counts().sort_index()"}
